entities.name: Authorization of UAV flight
entities.description: Network-supported USS authorization of UAV flight that can be performed using UUAA-SM procedure during PDN connectivity or bearer resource modification procedures.

entities.name: UUAA-SM procedure
entities.description: Procedure used for UAV flight authorization during PDN connectivity or bearer resource modification.

entities.name: PDN connectivity procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UAV flight authorization can be performed.

entities.name: Bearer resource modification procedure
entities.description: Procedure during which UAV flight authorization can be performed.

entities.name: Flight authorization information
entities.description: Authorization information provided by UE to network via protocol configuration options when available in the UE.

entities.name: Protocol configuration options
entities.description: IE used by UE to provide flight authorization information to the network.

entities.name: UAS services support
entities.description: UE capability to support UAS services and provide flight authorization information.

relations.description: Authorization of UAV flight is performed using the UUAA-SM procedure.
UUAA-SM procedure can be performed during PDN connectivity procedure.
UUAA-SM procedure can be performed during bearer resource modification procedure.
UE supporting UAS services may provide flight authorization information to the network.
Flight authorization information is provided via protocol configuration options.
